scenes.setting: Into the temple's basement: the upside-down Creator, murals of six evil gods ringing a corroded white cross, a cluster of 'mushrooms' burned back into rotten flesh and scalps — then an inner altar whose statue has open blood-red eyes, and behind it a curled-up child of seven or eight begging to be saved. 'My name… My name is Jack…'
After dinner, coat and hat on: Sharron must be found, the baronet's tunnel settled and mermaid clues gathered before Detective Moriarty leaves on his 'vacation'
scenes.text_anchor: before Detective Sherlock Moriarty headed south for a “vacation.”
